QuestInfo.name: Defeat Krexel
QuestInfo.0: Defeat Krexel, then talk to Commando Jim for powerful equipment.
QuestInfo.1: Commando Jim has offered to give you equipment with Krexel's powers if you can defeat the monster.
QuestInfo.2: You have received a Krexel Pauldron for taking down Krexel!

0.0: Krexel's a grade-A beasty, all right. I can see why Captain Latanica chose to call it up... but maybe there's a way for you to get a little bit of that power.\nHow would you like that?

yes.0: Defeat Krexel, and I'll make some equipment with its remains. \nMake it back alive, and the rewards are yours to take.

no.0: Couldn't take down Krexel, huh? That's the way it goes...

1.0: I know the memory of Krexel's power will forever haunt you, but at least you've got a little bit of that power for yourself!

yes.0: You are a true guardian of Ulu City!

mob.0: You didn't kill the Kerexel yet.
